description: Change of use of the existing unit from Class E (commercial office) to a self-contained two-bedroom dwelling (Class C3).
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-1a1fc03f-7fff-8b8c-404d-86a3bf8bca88"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of the insufficient information and inadequate provision of cycle parking, fails to demonstrate that cycle parking would be safe, secure and conveniently accessible for all users and encourage the use of sustainable modes of transport. The proposal would therefore be contrary to T5 (cycling) of the London Plan 2021 Policy LP42 (Walking and Cycling) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Hackney Transport Strategy 2015-2025.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-72302637-7fff-3b72-a574-4f98fa6520c7"></span></p><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space: pre-wrap; text-align: justify;">The proposed development, in the absence of an adequate noise impact assessment and layout details illustrating the means of access/egress, fails to demonstrate that the introduction of a noise-sensitive residential use would not compromise the continued operation of existing noise generating commercial uses within the host building or conversely, provide a suitable standard of residential living conditions with regard to noise and disturbance impacts. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policies LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP58 (Improving the Environment- Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and Policies D13 ( Agents of Change) and D14 (Noise) of the London Plan and P4 (Impact of development on existing activities) of the NPPF 2026.&nbsp;</span></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8a511a64-7fff-b543-4065-84063c56ea3d"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The applicant has failed to provide sufficient information in the form of a viability appraisal, nor agreed to enter a unilateral undertaking or S.106 Agreement&nbsp; to contribute towards affordable housing in the borough, therefore failing to demonstrate the development provides the maximum reasonable amount of affordable housing. The development therefore fails to accord with the requirements of policy LP13 (Affordable Housing) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), policy H4 (Delivering Affordable Housing) and Hackney's </span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">Planning Contributions SPD (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-9b671d5e-7fff-061d-8cf5-1cb6cf293511"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone, the proposed development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and policies T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan 2021.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-846f8dfb-7fff-2b8a-7c9f-f57dc2bb572f"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">In the absence of a robust Energy Statement and an Overheating Risk Assessment, the development fails to demonstrate how the maximum feasible reduction in carbon emissions and overheating mitigation have been achieved on site, contrary to policies LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change) and LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033) and policies SI 2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions) and SI 4 (Managing heat risk) of the London Plan 2021.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-c2d16d5d-7fff-b2d0-c4a2-d13be3ca367e"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by virtue of the loss of Class E employment floorspace would have a detrimental impact on overall function and vitality of the Shoreditch Priority Office Area and overall employment floorspace provision in the wider borough, contrary to policies E2 (Providing suitable business space) and of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP26 (Employment Land and Floorspace) and LP27 (Protecting and Promoting Office Floorspace in the Borough) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020). </span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-fd9aa3d8-7fff-e0ea-ba40-4c0043cd62b6"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of the insufficient information provided regarding waste storage and collection arrangements, fails to demonstrate that adequate and appropriate facilities would be provided for the storage and collection of household waste and recycling, to the detriment of the amenity of adjoining occupiers. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy LP57 (Waste) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033. </span></span></p>
